title: HHHusher features
description: A long cream section with a window-sized media frame pinned behind it all the way down (a 3D product in the original, a soft placeholder glow here) that brightens as the section arrives. The first screen has a big two-line heading at the top and a small paragraph with a yellow button lower down; then one feature per screen scrolls past in the right-hand column: a heading that rises in line by line, a paragraph that fades in, a yellow button and an arrow link.
notes: about one window tall per feature, plus one for the intro
media is pinned with position: sticky and cropped to the window; empty, a soft glow stands in
CSS scroll-driven; without support or with reduced motion everything shows in place
